Our story

A love written slowly

What began as quiet conversations soon became long calls, shared prayers, and a friendship neither of us saw coming. Through seasons of change, we found in each other a steady kind of love — patient, honest, and sure.

What started as a chance meeting has become a lifetime we now get to build, together, before God and the people we love most. And now, we begin our forever.
